# HTML entity encoder

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/html-entities/

Escape special characters for HTML text or decode common named and numeric character references into readable text.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Encode an ampersand and angle brackets before displaying a code example in a web page.

## Limits and checks

Escaping for HTML text is not a universal sanitizer for JavaScript, CSS, SQL or arbitrary attribute contexts.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
